description: Lists the team's social publishing automations with status, how they pick posts, channels and next run. Use when the user asks what is scheduled to post, which automations are on, or wants an automation ID. Not for run history (use list_social_automation_events). Returns automations with names, IDs and paging.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Results per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 20.

search.description: Text to match in automation names, e.g. "weekly". Omit to list everything.

sort_order.description: Sort direction: descend = newest first (default), ascend = oldest first.

source_mode.description: Filter by how posts are picked. How each run picks a post: manual_fixed = always the one post in drop_id; random_ready = shuffle among ready posts; ai_insights = AI picks the post that fits your Brand Kit mix and analytics. Omit for all.

status.description: Filter by state: active = runs on schedule; draft = off; paused = stopped after a social connection broke. Omit for all.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: list_social_automations
title: List publishing automations
